# Redshift Query

Runs a read-only query (one SELECT or WITH) on Amazon Redshift once per incoming envelope and yields one envelope per row, the columns written into DATA (Override: only the columns). The `@name`s are parameters, each a value or an expression on the envelope (sent as $1, $2..., never pasted into the text); a `{{name}}` is a schema or table name picked in the run (the parameter's value, checked: name or schema.name, letters, digits, _ and $). Connects with a connection profile of the workspace (its id in `connection`) or the component's own fields, the password always a secret.

- Type: `redshift` (Databases)
- Inputs: `in-0`
- Outputs: `out-0`
- Error port: `error` while `onError` is `divert`
- Output key: none (writes into DATA)
- Override: yes (the node's `override: true` makes what it produces the whole DATA)
- Writes outside the run: no

## Settings

| Key                  | Label             | Kind       | Required | Default                          | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| -------------------- | ----------------- | ---------- | -------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `connection`         | Connection        | connection |          |                                  | profile type `redshift`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `connectionName`     | Connection name   | value      | yes      | `{"value":"","expression":true}` | The name of a connection of the workspace, from $PARAMETERS, $VARIABLES and $SECRETS only: the same for every envelope. To use another connection per item, call a flow (Flow Invoker) with the name as a parameter.; only when connection is `"$dynamic"`; e.g. `'Orders_' + $PARAMETERS.env` |
| `host`               | Host              | text       | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""`; e.g. `db.example.com`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `port`               | Port              | number     | yes      | `"5439"`                         | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `database`           | Database          | text       | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `user`               | User              | text       | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `password`           | Password          | secret     | yes      |                                  | only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `ssl`                | SSL               | select     | yes      | `"on"`                           | one of `on`, `off`; only when connection is `""`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `sql`                | Query             | code       | yes      |                                  | sql; e.g. `SELECT id, name FROM sales.customers WHERE updated_at > @since`                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `parameters`         | Parameters        | list       |          |                                  | Each @name the query uses, with its value. A list of values for IN: split it in the query (e.g. split_to_array(@ids, ',')). A {{name}} in the query (e.g. FROM {{schema}}.briefs) is pasted as a name, after it is checked; a list of names is pasted as a, b, c.                              |
| `parameters[].name`  | Name              | text       | yes      |                                  | e.g. `since`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `parameters[].value` | Value             | value      |          | `{"value":"","expression":true}` | stored as the item's own `value` and `expression`; e.g. `$PARAMETERS.since`                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `timeoutS`           | Timeout (seconds) | number     |          | `300`                            | 1 to …                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

Every component also has `onError` (see [the flow format](../flow-format.md#on-error)).

## Example config

```yaml
connection: <connection profile id>
sql: SELECT email, name FROM sales.customers WHERE region = @region AND updated_at > @since
parameters:
    - name: region
      value: $region
      expression: true
    - name: since
      value: $PARAMETERS.since
      expression: true
timeoutS: 120
```
